brief:
Israeli forces removed a fence that settlers had installed on land belonging to the Nab'a al-Ghazal community in Al-Farisiyah, in the northern Jordan Valley, following a court order, Wafa reported. The action marked a rare enforcement of legal proceedings against settler encroachment in the West Bank.

Details of which court issued the order and the timeline of the removal were not specified in the report.
dek: Fence installed by settlers on West Bank land removed on court orders Israeli forces have removed a fence installed by settlers on land belonging to the Nab'a al-Ghazal community in Al-Farisiyah, in the northern Jordan Valley, Wafa reported.
title: Israeli forces remove settler fence from West Bank community land
